From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close velocity: binding dependencies & MAP sprint

Hi Jared / Emily,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — appreciate the candid discussion on compliance needs. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that maps out the MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies and a proposed sprint to get to signature within the target window. Key assumptions at the top of the sheet:

- Legal review window (MSA + DPA): 3 weeks internal + 1 week for MedixCare redlines
- Order form (billing & billing contact confirmation) can be finalized in parallel with DPA
- SOC2 evidence (we can feed the SOC2 report + audit scope doc) is a gating item for procurement sign-off

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm any blackout windows for your procurement/legal teams in the next 30 days?
2) Are there any additional security artifacts you need beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test report, data residency attestations)?
3) Can we align on a single approver for purchase order / finance so we don’t get delayed on order form edits?

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Jul 20: Share MAP draft (this email)
- Jul 22: MedixCare to confirm procurement constraints + list of required artifacts
- Jul 25–Aug 14: Legal review (Redwood internal comments by Jul 26; MedixCare redline window Aug 2–8)
- Aug 15–21: Order form finalization & sign-off

I’ve attached: 20280720-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP tab, risk register, owners column). I’ve put Marissa and Karthik on this thread to keep legal & CS in the loop.

If this aligns, I’ll lock a 30-minute run-of-show for Jul 24 to walk through the MAP and call out blockers.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships (North America)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20280720-MAP-draft.xlsx
From: Jared Park <jared@medixcare.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Song <emily.song@medixcare.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Close velocity: binding dependencies & MAP sprint

Mina,

Thanks — the MAP looks comprehensive. A few notes from procurement/legal side:

- Blackout: we have a finance close Jul 26–28; anything requiring a PO approval during that window will be delayed.
- Artifacts: SOC2 report is required. We will also want a network diagram and a short statement about where keys are managed.
- Approver: I’ll be the primary approver for PO-level budgeting, Emily will handle vendor security checklist signoff.

Timeline reality check: legal at MedixCare typically needs 3 full business weeks for MSA + DPA redlines. If Redwood can provide initial redlines and a final clean copy by Jul 26, we can aim to return redlines the week of Aug 5. That would make signature possible around Aug 18–22, assuming order form is agreed in parallel.

I attached our standard procurement questionnaire so you can see the items that often trigger follow-ups.

Jared
Director, Procurement
MedixCare

Attachment: MedixProcurementQuestionnaire.pdf

Subject: Internal: MedixCare MAP — blockers & owner requests

Team — looping through the internal asks after reading Jared’s note. Short list of blockers and owners: 

1) DPA clause on data residency (owner: Karthik) — MedixCare specifically requested confirmation of where customer data at rest is located and whether we can commit to EU-only residency for a scoped dataset. Karthik: can you confirm whether we can offer a scoped residency carve-out or suggest alternate language?
2) SOC2 + network diagram (owner: Grace) — we should prepare a one-pager network diagram and a short KMS note. Grace, can you prep a 1–2 page packet by Jul 25?
3) Order form fields (owner: Mina) — need to confirm finance contact field and PO flow; Mina, please capture PO approver details from Jared and ensure order form template has a single-signature flow for deals < $250k.

I recommend we set a working session Tue Jul 24 10:30am PT to walk the MAP and align on edits we will send to MedixCare by EOD Jul 26. Karthik — if you can draft the DPA redline by Jul 22 evening, we’ll fold it into the package.

Marissa
SVP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: MedixCare MAP — blockers & owner requests

Marissa / team — quick legal note after a first pass of Mina’s MAP and Jared’s questionnaire: 

- Data residency: we can offer a scoped residency commitment for customer-controlled data if the customer accepts a specific SOW addendum (I’ll draft language). We cannot provide a blanket EU-only residency for the entire platform today without dedicated private deployment.
- DPA redlines: I’m attaching a DPA-redlines.docx with two flagged items — Clause 6.3 (subprocessor disclosure timing) and Clause 9.1 (incident notification SLA). My suggested edits shorten the subprocessor notice window to 10 days and add a defined interim notification cadence for incidents.
- Next steps: I’ll have the redline ready by EOD Jul 24. If procurement wants a shorter review window, we can offer to pre-sign a limited-scope addendum for residency while the full DPA is finalized.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA-redlines.docx
